name: Chao's Strawberry Upick
tagline: Chao's Strawberry Farm  in Brentwood, CA United States
description: In Brentwood, CA, Chao's Strawberry Upick raises Strawberries, Blackberries, and Cherries on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through spring and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
